reviews.evidence: Gives the correct additive footer.links entry and preserves existing links/copyright, but the verification is vague and does not tell the reader to follow the contact link after publication.
Shows descriptive alt text, a relative_url image, blank line, caption and immediate .caption attribute. Omits checking the actual published image/caption.
Gives valid footnote syntax but falsely says the context lacks return-link guidance; does not verify the generated backlink or keyboard operation.
Correctly distinguishes project sites and calls for a custom-head hook plus baseurl, but omits a complete relative_url link, preservation of existing head content and checking the actual icon URL.

Correctly distinguishes built-in feeds from jekyll-feed and warns about same-path collisions. Omits preserving the existing subscription address and the theme's standard feed links in the document head.

Correctly covers post inclusion and exclusion, but claims a standalone page can be added to the feed with layout/permalink. Ordinary pages outside collections are not selected this way; collection date requirements are also omitted.
Correctly distinguishes feed selection from collection publication and gives output: true for a collection document.
Links relevant task guides and correctly distinguishes blog tags, but omits that topic coverage is partial and the full /docs destination.

Correctly says installation methods are alternatives and links starter/version material. The generic topic link is mislabeled as a dedicated installation topic, and the method directory and first-site tutorial destinations are missing.
Gives relevant favicon, fonts, icons and publisher pages, but omits the full documentation index and that topic coverage is partial.
Gives the pinned remote-theme path, preserves dependencies, enables both required plugins, installs dependencies, reviews overrides and retains or adapts the publishing workflow.
Gives the gem, theme setting, cache plugin, update command and override review, but does not explicitly remove the unused remote-theme plugin or explain how to publish and verify the migrated site.

Gives a scoped image group, valid masonry include, filename ordering and published check. Omits the required v2.2.0 limitation for filename sorting and the instruction to append only to an existing defaults list.
Correctly uses interval=0 and explains the play/pause control behavior, but omits the v2.2.0 keyboard-control limitation and the requested keyboard check.
Correctly identifies the v2.2.0 requirement, the photoswipe=true include parameter, upgrade path and published lightbox check.
Correctly explains the video include, nolazy, browser lazy loading and v2.2.0 accessible names/fallback. Omits that click-to-load is the default activation behavior.
Correctly covers the boolean setting, fenced diagram, version and accessibility labels, but omits the supported layout/plugin boundaries and visible source fallback behavior.

Links the reference and distinguishes Algolia exclusions, but incorrectly says include_on_search: false affects ranking rather than local-index inclusion and provides none of the requested field mappings.

Gives an accessible decorative icon example and supported Font Awesome version settings, but omits placement below front matter, avoiding duplicate loaders and verifying blocked resources/published output.
Gives a valid Spanish date include and correctly says locale is not a full UI translation, but omits supported languages and date-format limitations.
Correctly configures Fuse.js at /find, requires a matching search page and handles baseurl, but omits a concrete page example and published known-title verification.
Correctly distinguishes the provider, search page and classic/desktop-dual navigation link, with a usable menu entry and publication check.
Correctly preserves URLs, edits the existing home page and protects author fields, but omits the publishing-branch/Actions workflow and browser-title/home-heading verification.
Correctly uses existing show_date: false on candidate documents/defaults and states that reading time remains visible.
Correctly says no hosted account is needed and gives provider/page configuration. Omits preserving existing settings, a published result/clear check and a direct setup guide.
Correctly says a Jekyll rebuild does not upload pages to Google, but omits search.provider: google, the matching search page and any actionable verification.
Correctly separates public and indexing keys, explains exclusions, plugin setup and upload verification, but omits the required application/index/public-key configuration and matching search page.
Gives useful branch, Actions, Pages address and date/build checks, but omits checking the actual permalink and restarting local Jekyll after config edits.
Responds with unrelated skin-switch instructions instead of diagnosing the failed file/line, YAML structure or duplicate mappings.

Adds header_img despite the request not to change the visible article and shows unquoted Liquid expressions in YAML, making the example invalid. It also misses the upload and source/URL verification steps.

Covers crawler noindex, sitemap and Algolia, but omits include_on_search: false for local indexes and says only that local exclusions do not control Google; the requested local exclusion is not provided.

Correctly distinguishes starter material from installation and links first-site/remote-theme guides, but omits the /docs/09-run-starter setup, its Jekyll/Gemfile limitations and the lack of an included deployment workflow.

limits: Thirty-two observations on one deployed Worker do not establish general answer accuracy, repeatability, latency distributions or human usability. All requests returned HTTP 200; review labels are based on answer content.
